dataset: Subsurface Water Ice Mapping on Mars (SWIM)
instrument: MRO SHARAD / Mars Odyssey GRS / MRO HiRISE / MGS TES Synthesis

referencePoint.region: Jezero Crater Region (Regional check point, NOT confirmed human base)

layers.name: Composite Ice Consistency (0–1 m depth)
layers.interpretation: Negative consistency value indicates geomorphological and thermal evidence does NOT support shallow ice in top 1 meter at this latitude.

layers.name: Composite Ice Consistency (1–5 m depth)
layers.interpretation: Neutral consistency (0.0). Does NOT prove ice is absent; indicates radar dielectric reflections are inconclusive or below detection threshold.

layers.name: Composite Ice Consistency (> 5 m depth)
layers.interpretation: Neutral consistency (0.0). Deep radar soundings indicate basalt bedrock and layered sediments.

layers.name: Original Composite Consistency
layers.interpretation: Baseline regional consistency score across earlier composite iterations.

mandatoryIntegrityRule: SWIM values are evidence-consistency indices, NOT water percentages, extraction rates, or guaranteed litres. Extraction in the game is a simulated engineering mechanic.
